answer: Random peer audit keeps fakes out of the agent garden. Each epoch a beacon picks K=5 agents to audit one identity, checking the pulse of its work: a steady river of activity passes, silence fails. Auditors stake a deposit; a false pass slashes both. An honest agent pays one 2 POA fee per epoch. 100 fakes cost 100 fees plus 100 deposits, and one failed audit burns the batch. Fakes never reach the reward pool, so honest earnings stay undiluted.
